entities.name: Predrag Ostojić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Predrag Ostojić was a Yugoslav chess player. Born in Kraljevo, he won the Yugoslav Chess Championship in 1968 and 1971. FIDE awarded Ostojić the title of International Master in 1968, and Grandmaster in 1975.
